entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return. Order number is 994-Tango-Zulu. Just need the label.
Certainly, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 994-Tango-Zulu. I see it's for the Apex cycling jersey. What specifically is the issue with it?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is just too tight across the chest. I want to do an exchange or just get my money back.

I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Looking at the delivery date, it was 85 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return policy for standard apparel, so we can definitely process that for you.
Great. So you're sending the label?
Yes. I'm processing the return now. Would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?

You got it. The return label has just been sent to the email address on file. And since you're a VIP member with us, I've gone ahead and added a free expedited shipping credit to your account for your next purchase. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thanks for the quick help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
